notes.title: How it's calculated
notes.revenue: Revenue: the amount net of VAT and withholding of the invoices issued in the period (credit notes subtract on their own date). It goes to a project when the line comes from that project's contract; if the contract has several projects, it's split among them by their hours in the period.
notes.allocation: Whatever is invoiced outside a contract (or from contracts without a project) is split among the client's projects without a contract by their hours in the period (marked “By hours”). If none has hours, it stays under “No project”.
notes.receipts: Payments without an invoice (what's recorded while invoices aren't issued from GNERAI OS): they count as revenue as they are, with no VAT to take out, on the day the money arrived, and as collected too. If they have a project, they go to that project (“Direct receipt”); if not, they're split like whatever is invoiced outside a contract.
notes.cost: Cost: the hours, the client's expenses and its share of the infrastructure. Every logged hour is valued at the hourly cost its author had that day (Settings → Team); non-billable hours count too.
notes.expenses: Expenses: those assigned to the client with an invoice date in the period, at their Finance cost (the net amount and, if the VAT isn't deductible, the VAT too). They belong to the client, not to a project: they go on its row (“Other costs”) and not on its projects' rows.
notes.hosting: Infrastructure: each expense shared among hosted websites is split equally among the websites we host that are active today in Websites, and each client adds up its own; a client doesn't carry anything from before its first invoice or its first direct expense. That share and the share of websites without a client stay under “Infrastructure without a client”, outside the totals. Subscriptions count through the expenses they generate (each charge, on its date), never through their fee: nothing is counted twice.
notes.rebill: Rebilled: an expense rebilled to the client is a cost on its date and its invoice line is revenue once issued, so only the markup stays in the margin. Until it's invoiced it weighs as a cost (“Not rebilled yet”).
notes.collection: Collected and outstanding (a cash view: they don't count in the margin, which is still on revenue net of VAT): collected are the invoice payments recorded with a date in the period, VAT included, whether from invoices of the period or earlier ones, plus the payments without an invoice in the period; outstanding is what's still unpaid today from the invoices issued in the period, VAT included too.
notes.lifetime: All time: from the first issued invoice, the first payment without an invoice or the first cost until today. Imported historical invoices count like any other issued invoice, and their payments like any payment.
notes.defaultCost: {hours} were valued at the default cost ({amount}/h): they belong to people with no cost of their own that day.

empty.title: The team's hourly cost is missing

costs.title: Internal hourly cost
costs.description: What each hour of each person costs the organization (salary, social security, tools…), from a given date. It's what client and project profitability is calculated with. Only partners can see it.
costs.readOnly: Only an owner can change costs.
costs.sheetDescription: Each cost applies from its date until the next one. Changing it from a given day doesn't touch what came before.
costs.validFromHint: If there's already a cost on that same day, it's corrected.
costs.historyEmpty: No cost yet: their hours are valued at the organization's.
costs.deleteBody: The cost from {date} will be deleted: those hours will be valued at the previous one.
